title: Lady Gaga's Boyfriend Quietly Plans: Training AI with Living Skin. How Is This Biotech Startup Revolutionizing Beauty R&D?
excerpt: Beyond the spotlight of Silicon Valley, a biotech startup named Outer Biosciences is quietly revolutionizing the fundamental logic of beauty and medical researc
content_html:
Beyond the spotlight of Silicon Valley, a biotech startup named Outer Biosciences is quietly revolutionizing the fundamental logic of beauty and medical research. Its co-founder is Michael Polansky, the partner of the renowned singer Lady Gaga. Over the past few years, the company has been working on solving a key industry challenge: how to maintain the viability of human living tissues outside the body for extended periods and integrate them deeply with artificial intelligence.

Traditional biological and chemical innovations have always struggled to keep up with the iteration speed of software development. The core reason is that it is ethically impossible to conduct high-risk experiments directly on living humans. Scientists have instead used animal models, simple cell cultures, or lab-grown organoids, which often fail to accurately replicate complex human organ reactions. To break through this bottleneck, Outer Biosciences has taken an entirely different approach.

The company obtains human skin tissue that would otherwise be discarded after plastic surgery from strictly reviewed non-profit and commercial biobanks, such as the National Disease Research Interchange. Under strict supervision by institutional review boards and with donor consent, its team successfully extended the survival time of living skin tissue in vitro to one month. In contrast, the industry standard for tissue maintenance typically lasts only a few days, which is only suitable for acute toxicity testing and completely unable to observe slow biological processes such as collagen remodeling, pigmentation, or barrier repair, which take weeks to manifest.

More significantly, Outer Biosciences feeds this "long-lasting" living skin data directly into a closed-loop self-enhancing AI model. This model can predict which untested chemical ingredients may have positive effects on specific skin functions and then tests these ingredients in the living tissue system. Regardless of whether the prediction is accurate, the test results are immediately fed back into the model to optimize the next round of iterations. This perfect closed-loop operation mode of combining a living skin system with AI prediction has significantly accelerated the development of new ingredients.

In terms of business model, Outer Biosciences does not directly launch its own consumer brands. Instead, it standardizes the efficient ingredients developed and provides them to mainstream beauty and pharmaceutical companies through licensing or sales after passing safety tests. Currently, the company has successfully cultivated several highly commercially viable candidate ingredients and is collaborating with pharmaceutical partners to study the causes of severe skin rashes caused by certain cancer drugs.

Although the team is currently small and much of the AI work runs directly on local servers to protect data privacy, this low-key company is opening a new innovation gap in the traditional beauty and medical testing fields with its unique "living skin + AI" dual-driven model.
